title: independent_expenditure
description: One expenditure for or against a candidate, from the FEC's file of committees' spending on and gifts to candidates (`pas2`): an independent expenditure, a party's coordinated expenditure or a communication cost, told apart by `kind`. Only `kind = 'ie'` is independent expenditure. Never a contribution. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

source_record_id.description: The FEC's id of the row (`SUB_ID`), unique within a source.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

committee_id.description: The FEC id of the committee that spent the money.

candidate_id.description: The FEC id of the candidate the filing names, when they are a candidate of the cycle, else null. Where the FEC coded another candidate's id, a hand-curated list restores the filed one; a second id the same person holds for the race is replaced by the one holding their money; and spending naming a candidate whose committee was handed to another (Biden's 2024 campaign, Harris's from 2024-07-21), dated on or after the handoff, is the second candidate's.

race_id.description: That candidate's race, the `race` table's key; null when there is none.

support_oppose.description: `S` for spending in support of the candidate, `O` in opposition.

amount.description: The amount in dollars, as filed. A correction may be negative and nets out in any sum.

date.description: The date of the expenditure as filed; null when the filer gave none.

kind.description: `ie` for an independent expenditure (24E, 24A), `coordinated` for a party's coordinated expenditure (24C), `communication_cost` for a Form 7 filer's communication cost (24F, 24N).
